title: Purpose Inside a Hypothesis
goal: Add a purpose clause to a hypothetical sentence, with the imperfect subjunctive after the conditional.

items: I can add a purpose clause to a hypothetical sentence with the imperfect subjunctive.
I can use the same pattern with the past conditional.
I can use the new words for determination and effort.
